skills.description: Manage OneHop Codex model configs entirely through chat. Support four modes: list, sync, switch, and status. List remote supported models, sync one config per model into ~/.codex/onehop, switch by copying a saved model config to ~/.codex/config.toml, and show current model status with a live model test.
skills.description_zh:
简要说明
这个 skill 是用来帮你管理 第三方例如OneHop 的模型在codex配置，适合不想手动改配置文件的用户。
第一步先做什么
先把你的 baseurl 和 api-key 发到聊天里。
示例：
baseurl https://api.onehop.ai/v1
api-key 你的密钥
有了这两个信息之后，skill 才能读取模型、同步配置、检查当前模型状态。
然后怎么用
你再在聊天里输入下面几种用法：
list：查看BaseURL的可用模型和本地配置
sync：同步模型配置到本地，同时会备份您的现在在用的Codex的配置文件
switch 模型名：切换到指定模型
status：查看当前模型是否正常工作
推荐顺序：先发 baseurl 和 api-key，然后 list -> sync -> switch 模型名 -> status
skills.name: OneHop codex config

Covers 5 use cases: ① Daily Meditation Practice — use a daily meditation to center yourself and connect with your inner wisdom ("Give me a meditation for today" "What should I focus on today" "Daily reflection") ② Trusting Your Soul — learn to trust your inner guidance instead of external validation ("How do I trust myself" "Why can't I hear my inner voice" "Learning to listen to my soul") ③ Creative Awakening — unlock creative energy by connecting with your authentic self ("I feel creatively blocked" "How do I access my creativity" "Finding inspiration") ④ Spiritual Growth — navigate the path of spiritual development with compassion and patience ("How do I grow spiritually" "What does spiritual growth look like" "Feeling stuck on my spiritual path") ⑤ Healing and Letting Go — release past wounds and embrace the present moment ("How do I heal from the past" "Letting go of what hurts" "Finding peace")  Trigger when users say: "Daily meditation" "Melody Beattie" "Journey to the heart" "Spiritual growth" "Trust my soul" "Inner wisdom" "Daily reflection" "Creative block" "Letting go" "Healing meditation" "Soul journey" "Spiritual practice" or mention: Melody Beattie / journey to the heart / meditation / soul / spiritual / inner wisdom / creativity / healing / letting go.  Related skills: be-here-now (presence), the-power-of-now (mindfulness), the-miracle-of-mindfulness (meditation), radically-happy (gratitude), the-mountain-is-you (self-mastery).
